preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(n) and 3 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n])
preconditions.description: Each test case has an integer n between 3 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and all(a_i == int(a_i) and 1 <= a_i <= 100 for a_i in a) for a in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n and line.split()[0] == 'a'])
preconditions.description: Each sequence a has exactly n integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(b) == n and all(b_i == int(b_i) and 1 <= b_i <= 100 for b_i in b) for b in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n and line.split()[0] == 'b'])
preconditions.description: Each sequence b has exactly n integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(c) == n and all(c_i == int(c_i) and 1 <= c_i <= 100 for c_i in c) for c in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n and line.split()[0] == 'c'])
preconditions.description: Each sequence c has exactly n integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_i and a_i != c_i and b_i != c_i for a_i, b_i, c_i in zip(a, b, c))
preconditions.description: For each i, a_i, b_i, and c_i are all distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i in {a_i, b_i, c_i} for p_i, a_i, b_i, c_i in zip(p, a, b, c))
postconditions.description: Each element p_i in the output sequence is one of {a_i, b_i, c_i}.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i != p_j for i, j in [(i, (i % n) + 1) for i in range(n)])
postconditions.description: No two adjacent elements in the output sequence (including the first and last) are equal.
